Carrying lunch from home a few days a week usually costs less than buying it daily. Also, buy staples like rice, beans and maize flour in larger packs when you can!

summary.summary: In this session, you reported spending a total of KES 200. Your entire expenditure went towards food after buying chips. Keeping track of small snack purchases is a great step toward better budgeting.
ways_to_save: Prepare cheap snacks like boiled maize, eggs, or sweet potatoes at home to avoid buying takeaway chips.
Set a strict weekly snack allowance on M-Pesa to keep small daily food expenses from accumulating.
Buy raw potatoes from local mama mbogas in bulk if you want to make your own fried chips at a fraction of the cost.
